fields.name: input_mask
fields.label: Region Mask
fields.tooltip: RGBA PNG whose alpha channel marks the region. Standalone: region semantics for this lane. Alongside lanpaint: the inpaint region — present with image1, the builder switches to the lanpaint sampler.

fields.name: mask_mode
fields.label: Region Mode
fields.tooltip: How the mask is honored: auto (the lane's own region ControlNet if its weights are present, else crop+stitch), crop_stitch (crop to the mask + context, work the crop, composite back — pixels outside the mask never change), full_frame (legacy whole-image pass; unmasked regions may drift).

fields.name: mask_context_pad
fields.label: Context Padding
fields.tooltip: Pixels of surrounding context kept in the crop (crop_stitch mode). More context = more coherence; 64 is the sweet spot.

fields.name: mask_grow
fields.label: Grow / Shrink
fields.tooltip: Expand (+) or shrink (−) the region by an exact pixel disk before the run. Applied host-side.

fields.name: mask_feather
fields.label: Feather
fields.tooltip: Gaussian falloff the composite blends through — kills the pasted-on rectangle edge.

fields.name: mask_threshold
fields.label: Re-threshold
fields.tooltip: Re-binarize the feathered mask at this level. 0 = keep the soft falloff.

fields.name: mask_invert
fields.label: Invert
fields.tooltip: Work OUTSIDE the painted region instead.
